segments.sn35.110:1.3: Katame ca, bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, katamañca upādānaṃ?
segments.sn35.110:1.5: Yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ … pe … jivhā upādāniyo dhammo … pe … mano upādāniyo dhammo.
segments.sn35.110:1.8: Yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.110:1.9: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, idaṃ upādānan”ti.

lines: 105-113. Dutiye vedanāsukhadukkhaṃ kathitaṃ, taṃ pana vipākasukhadukkhaṃ vaṭṭati.
Pañcamādīsu yaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, taṃ khandhiyavagge vuttanayameva.
“Ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhan”ti vuttattā vimuttisukhassa ca saḷāyatanadukkhassa ca kathitattā vivaṭṭasukhaṃ cettha kathitamevāti sakkā viññātuṃ.
Kāmaṃ khandhiyavagge khandhavasena desanā āgatā, na āyatanavasena.
Ettha pana vattabbaṃ atthajātaṃ khandhiyavagge vuttanayamevāti.
